text:
keera: Flagging a subtle one: new internal header `x-route-delegate` we started emitting to support delegated routing is causing some SDKs to double-count quotas when they construct route keys.
dan: Can you explain the duplication?
keera: Sure. Previously SDKs built a route key from service+route. With x-route-delegate present we intended servers to treat it as routing only (no billing), but older SDKs append delegate into the client-side route fingerprint so console shows duplicate route entries and quota burn doubles.
paul: Oof. That's bad for customers on tight quota plans. Which SDKs are affected?
keera: We saw TS and Go clients in the field. Python's client-side router ignores unknown headers so it's fine. The issue is naive SDKs include any routing headers into the request identity used for local metrics aggregation.
anya: Quick mitigation: SDKs should whitelist routing headers that affect routing decisions vs non-billing delegate headers. We should ship a very small change: ignore `x-route-delegate` for quota-key construction.
dan: Proposed TS patch: ```ts
// route key builder
const routeParts = [req.service, req.route];
if (headers['x-route-priority']) routeParts.push(headers['x-route-priority']);
// DO NOT include x-route-delegate in key
return routeParts.join('#');
```
paul: Go patch: use `http.Header.Get` but explicit ignore for `x-route-delegate` and `x-internal-hint`. I'll open PR and add unit.
keera: Also need a Console diff: collapse duplicated routes in quota UI and show a hint that delegate headers don't incur billing. Product asked for a tooltip: "delegate header - routing only".
anya: Rollout plan: 1) quick opt-in SDK patch behind env var `IGNORE_DELEGATE_IN_KEY` 2) backend emit `x-route-delegate` for 5% tenants with admin toggle 3) after 24h expand and flip opt-in default in SDKs 4) Console update to group delegate routes.
dan: Infra note: infra-bot says toggling delegate emission requires feature-flag flip, no DB migration.
infra-bot: Feature flag `delegate-routing` created. No DB schema changes required. Maintenance window not needed.
paul: CI checklist: unit test for key builder, integration test asserting Console quota aggregation unaffected, changelog entry.
keera: Docs: we'll add a short migration note: "If you build custom route metrics from client-side keys, upgrade SDKs to v3.1.0+ to avoid delegate headers being included."
anya: Can we add a short lint in SDKs to warn if custom telemetry includes non-whitelisted headers?
dan: Yes; I'll add a developer warning when `INCLUDE_ALL_HEADERS_IN_KEY` env var is set true; default false.
keera: Thanks folks. Let's prioritize the TS and Go PRs; Python team can skip opt-in. I'll post status in #release-war-room when PRs are merged.
